theorem GPointwiseConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM_kernel.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [inst_2 : MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [inst_4 : mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [inst_5 : SigmaFinite mu] [inst_6 : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] [mu.IsInvInvariant]
  (l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (h : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous h)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport h) (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
  (↑↑((PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs h hh hc) F) =ᶠ[ae mu] fun x =>
      ↑(PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x)) *
        ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
          h (x * y⁻¹) *
            (↑↑F y / ↑(PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K y))) ∂mu) ∧
    ∀ᵐ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K) ∂mu,
      Integrable
        (fun y =>
          h (x * y⁻¹) *

        mu :=
fun K [Field K] [NumberField K] [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
    [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] mu [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SigmaFinite mu]
    [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] [mu.IsInvInvariant] l r s hlr hs h hh hc F =>
  let f := fun y => ↑↑F y / ↑(PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K y));
  have ht := GPointwiseConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM_measured K mu l r s hlr hs h hh hc F;
  have he := fun x =>
    Trans.trans
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg (fun x_1 => ∫ (x_2 : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), h x_2 * f (x_2⁻¹ * x) ∂mu = integral mu x_1)
          (funext fun x_1 =>
            congrArg (fun x_2 => h (x * x_1) * f x_2)
              (Eq.trans (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x_2 => x_2 * x) (mul_inv_rev x x_1)) (mul_assoc x_1⁻¹ x⁻¹ x))
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul x_1⁻¹) (inv_mul_cancel x)) (mul_one x_1⁻¹)))))
        (Eq.symm (integral_mul_left_eq_self (fun g => h g * f (g⁻¹ * x)) x)))
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg (fun x_1 => ∫ (x_2 : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), h (x * x_2) * f x_2⁻¹ ∂mu = integral mu x_1)
          (funext fun x_1 => congrArg (fun x_2 => h (x * x_1⁻¹) * f x_2) (inv_inv x_1)))
        (Eq.symm (integral_inv_eq_self (fun y => h (x * y) * f y⁻¹) mu)));
  ⟨mp_mem ht.left
      (univ_mem'
        (id fun x hx =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  _a =
                    ↑(PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x)) *
                      ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                        h (x * y⁻¹) *
                          (↑↑F y /
                            ↑(PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s
                                (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K y))) ∂mu)
                hx))
            (congrArg
              (fun z => ↑(PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x)) * z)
              (he x)))),
    mp_mem ht.right
      (univ_mem'
        (id fun x hx =>
          have hm := MeasurePreserving.comp (measurePreserving_mul_left mu x) (Measure.measurePreserving_inv mu);
          have hi := (MeasurePreserving.integrable_comp hm (Integrable.aestronglyMeasurable hx)).mpr hx;
          Eq.mp
            (congrArg (fun x => Integrable x mu)
              (funext fun x_1 =>
                congrArg (HMul.hMul (h (x * x_1⁻¹)))
                  (congr
                    (congrArg (fun x => HDiv.hDiv (↑↑F x))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (Eq.trans
                          (congrArg (fun x_2 => x_2 * x)
                            (Eq.trans (mul_inv_rev x x_1⁻¹) (congrArg (fun x_2 => x_2 * x⁻¹) (inv_inv x_1))))
                          (mul_assoc x_1 x⁻¹ x))
                        (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul x_1) (inv_mul_cancel x)) (mul_one x_1))))
                    (congrArg
                      (fun x =>
                        ↑(PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x)))
                      (Eq.trans
                        (Eq.trans
                          (congrArg (fun x_2 => x_2 * x)
                            (Eq.trans (mul_inv_rev x x_1⁻¹) (congrArg (fun x_2 => x_2 * x⁻¹) (inv_inv x_1))))
                          (mul_assoc x_1 x⁻¹ x))
                        (Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul x_1) (inv_mul_cancel x)) (mul_one x_1)))))))
            hi))⟩
